svg.text: ZenUML Lite paywall — runtime flow (production, default-on since 2026-08-09)
Sources: pageBanner.ts · warningBanner.ts · spaceAdminProbe.ts · mountPaywallGate.ts · continueAttempts.ts · useCustomerSuccessService.ts · MacroMetrics.ts · UpgradePrompt.vue · generated 2026-09-02
1 · Page load on a Lite site — the page-banner iframe resolves the paywall state
2 · Editor mount — the only enforcement point (Publish and the persistence layer are never gated)
3 · Known failure shapes (measured) and the numbers to remember
on every page of a Lite site
→ paywall off for the whole site
last 30 d → most admins never see it
spot check: modal at editor mount,
Amber loop: once a license or exemption
is written, the next page load re-reads
KV → spacePaid / paywall off → the gate
does not fire (rails 1–3 share one trunk).
